owner: Angelea McCullough, Founder of RMS Global Publishing

discord_model.rule: Participating external-community members must voluntarily join Discord and complete Reset onboarding before shared Arena access. Origin community may be attributed for analytics and leader credit, but members are not siloed by source after onboarding.

payment_model.rule: Support, Studio project deposits, Event booking deposits, and any future Studio membership subscriptions remain separate Stripe lanes with separate products, fulfillment language, and entitlement logic.

remaining_explicit_bindings: Studio membership checkout remains gated until distinct membership products/prices, entitlement fulfillment, Drive access lifecycle, cancellation/revocation behavior, and production certification are explicitly bound.
RMS/CreatorHub secure communications ingress must be production-certified before RESET_INTELLIGENCE_INGRESS_URL and RESET_INTELLIGENCE_INGRESS_SECRET are activated in Netlify.
do_not_do: Do not auto-enroll Facebook group members into Discord.
Do not scrape Facebook member lists or private posts.
Do not create artificial engagement or engagement-for-engagement automation that risks platform enforcement.
Do not use one Stripe payment link for both voluntary support and paid services.
Do not expose Stripe, Resend, Zoho, Google, Supabase or communications secrets in browser code.
